scientific_question: With one frozen H1.18 student-recovery corpus, is the information usable through text memory, parametric SD-LoRA, or neither on held-out WebShop tasks?
hypothesis: H1.18 found no cross-partition selective recovery gain. This matched carrier diagnostic tests whether the bottleneck is parametric internalization or broader experience/interface usability.

arms.BASE: frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct with no experience and no adapter
arms.TEXT_MEMORY: frozen base with deterministic top-1 lexical retrieval from the frozen H1.18 student-recovery corpus injected at every evaluation step
arms.PARAMETRIC: frozen base reloaded with the already-fitted H1.18 student-recovery SD-LoRA adapter; no refit or sweep

shared_experience.evaluation_access: train-only corpus; no evaluation task, seed, score, trace, or outcome may enter the bank

frozen_variables.text_memory_retrieval: top-1 token-set cosine; event_id tie-break; max retrieved prompt 1400 chars

contamination_checks: training task IDs are disjoint from all eight evaluation task IDs
evaluation seeds are not used to create the shared experience corpus
TEXT_MEMORY and PARAMETRIC consume the same records_sha256
no teacher, held-out outcome, or post-test prompt change is allowed
each cell has an isolated seed-root and explicit GPU UUID

resource_budget.parallelism: wave 1: BASE P1-P4 and TEXT_MEMORY P1-P4 on all eight UUID-bound GPUs; wave 2: PARAMETRIC P1-P4 on four GPUs
resource_budget.expected_gpu_hours: 12 measured cell wall-times; no occupancy-only work
resource_budget.gpu_policy: use only idle authorized GPUs; release them after each wave

tracking.offline_exception: only if online initialization or upload fails; record the exact error and preserve the local spool for later sync

primary_metrics: mean final task score over all attempts
diagnostics: adapter reload identity and protocol fingerprint
stop_rule: one bounded carrier diagnostic; no rank/LR/epoch sweep, no prompt rescue, no repeated seeds

branch_rule.text_memory_positive_parametric_negative: classify parametric internalization bottleneck; preregister one localized parametric mechanism only after reconciliation
branch_rule.both_negative: classify base-agent/interface/experience-usability bottleneck; stop adapter micro-variants
branch_rule.parametric_positive: replicate on fresh task IDs and seeds before discussing Q3
branch_rule.task_specific_or_mixed: retain heterogeneity and keep Q3/H2/D0/retention/transfer/SEED closed
branch_rule.invalid: repair only runtime/provenance contract; do not alter carrier semantics or denominator

upstream_audit.decision: retain pinned runtime; no upstream change affects this freshly preregistered WebShop carrier diagnostic

claim_boundary: Carrier diagnosis only. This group cannot by itself open Q3, H2, D0, retention/transfer, or SEED.
artifact_policy: raw traces, adapter weights, datasets, and caches remain on the server; GitHub receives the queue and compact evidence index only

execution_result.excluded_operational_attempts: The first eight cache-path attempts failed before episode creation because the model identifier was passed instead of the local cached model path; retained outside the denominator.
